jobs.title: GIS Specialist – Production
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a GIS Specialist – Production to support a mission\-focused GIS Service Center delivering enterprise geospatial products, services, and technical support. This role is responsible for production coordination, quality control, database/map product release, vendor coordination, and enterprise workflow support, while working closely with the Service Center Manager and broader GIS team to maintain a reliable GIS operating environment.
***\*Please note, this is not a traditional full‑time position. It is a deployment‑based, on\-call position. Team members must be located near Sacramento, CA.****﻿*The projected range for this position is $40 to $50 hourly. Depending upon other factors, i.e., skills, experience, location, market conditions, the range may vary slightly. These ranges are for CA only.
Responsibilities**Production Coordination \& Quality Control*** Implement and manage quality control (QC) procedures to ensure deliverables meet established standards for accuracy, completeness, and usability.
* Oversee procedures performed by associate specialists and technicians to ensure consistent production methods and adherence to workflows.
* Approve and release final product databases, maps, and reports when delegated by the Service Center Manager.
* Work independently on assigned production tasks while contributing effectively within an interdisciplinary GIS team supporting enterprise and regional priorities.

**Enterprise Workflow \& Database Support*** Perform mapping and database management functions across multiple project types and operational needs.
* Create and maintain schemas and workflow procedures that support enterprise GIS operations and repeatable production.
* Monitor and help ensure proper data backups and sound data stewardship practices.

**Operations Support \& Vendor Coordination*** Coordinate with hardware/software vendors to support a stable, problem\-free operating environment.
* Assist the Service Center Manager with user and project setup, accounting, and security activities as needed for operational readiness.
* Support management and use of data collection technologies to meet program needs.

**Required Skills \& Required Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in natural sciences, engineering, computer sciences, geography/GIS, or related discipline (or equivalent relevant experience).
* Demonstrated working knowledge of the Esri platform, including ArcGIS Pro and common extensions (e.g., Spatial Analyst), with solid cartography and production mapping skills.
* 3\+ years of experience with Python and/or ModelBuilder supporting GIS automation and production workflows.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests, follow established procedures, and deliver accurate products under schedule requirements (consistent with production/QC responsibilities).
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity and production QC.
* Practical understanding of enterprise GIS operations, repeatable workflows, and controlled data releases.
* Effective communicator who can coordinate with technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders to resolve issues efficiently.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience with ArcGIS Server and enterprise geodatabase configurations (e.g., ArcSDE) and/or similar enterprise GIS technologies.
* Experience with ArcGIS Online administration (content management, users/roles, governance).
* Recent completion (within \~2 years) of relevant Esri training such as ArcGIS Pro, geodatabases, cartographic production, 3D/visualization, or field workflow modernization (may substitute for some experience per contract guidance).

**Must have a valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to pass a driving record background check.**

jobs.title: GIS Specialist - Service Center Manager and Application Developer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Consulting GIS Specialist – Service Center Manager and Site Supervisor/Application Developer to lead delivery of enterprise geospatial services in support of federal clients. This position provides technical leadership, operational management, and advanced GIS application development for a multi\-disciplinary GIS Service Center supporting mission\-critical geospatial programs. The successful candidate will oversee staff, manage enterprise GIS infrastructure, and develop custom applications that support data\-driven decision\-making across water resources, environmental compliance, land management, and infrastructure programs.
***\*Please note, this is not a traditional full‑time position. It is a deployment‑based, on\-call position. Team members must be located near Sacramento, CA.****﻿*The projected range for this position is $45 to $65 hourly. Depending upon other factors, i.e., skills, experience, location, market conditions, the range may vary slightly. These ranges are for CA only.
Responsibilities**Service Center Leadership \& Operations*** Manage day\-to\-day operations of the GIS Service Center, including workload planning, staffing, scheduling, and performance oversight
* Supervise GIS specialists, developers, and technicians; assign tasks and monitor production quality, schedule adherence, and deliverable completeness
* Provide administrative oversight including coordination of staffing, training, travel, and resource planning
* Ensure compliance with client policies, standards, security requirements, and enterprise GIS governance
* Prepare and deliver status reports, management reports, and performance metrics to stakeholders

**nterprise GIS \& Systems Management*** Oversee administration and maintenance of enterprise GIS systems, including ArcGIS Enterprise, cloud environments, and geospatial databases
* Ensure system availability, performance, security, backup, and disaster recovery
* Coordinate with IT teams on system architecture, upgrades, configurations, and integration
* Maintain integrity, accessibility, and lifecycle management of enterprise geospatial data

**Application Development \& Technical Delivery*** Lead design and development of custom GIS applications, tools, and workflows using ESRI technologies and modern programming frameworks
* Develop web\-based GIS solutions, dashboards, and data services using platforms such as ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise
* Build automation tools and analytical models to support geospatial workflows and decision\-making
* Integrate GIS with external systems, environmental models, and enterprise data platforms

**Geospatial Analysis \& Program Support*** Provide advanced geospatial analysis, modeling, and visualization to support programs such as:
* Water resource management and modeling
* Land use and land ownership analysis
* Environmental compliance (e.g., ESA, NEPA)
* Emergency response and flood inundation mapping
* Support development of maps, reports, dashboards, and analytical products

**Client Support, Training \& Collaboration*** Serve as primary point of contact for GIS technical support and user engagement
* Provide help desk support and troubleshooting for GIS applications and systems
* Develop and deliver training for end users on GIS tools, workflows, and data management
* Collaborate with planners, engineers, scientists, and IT staff to deliver integrated solutions

**Strategic Planning \& Innovation*** Evaluate emerging geospatial technologies and recommend enhancements to improve service delivery
* Forecast workload, staffing needs, and infrastructure requirements
* Support continuous improvement of GIS services, workflows, and enterprise capabilities

**Required Skills \& Required Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 8\+ years of progressive GIS experience, including enterprise GIS and application development
* 3\+ years of experience in a supervisory or team leadership role
* ESRI platform expertise (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online)
* Programming experience in one or more of:
* Python
* JavaScript (APIs, web mapping)
* C\#, .NET, or similar
* Experience with:
* Geospatial database design and management (e.g., SQL Server, ArcSDE)
* Web GIS development and deployment
* Cloud or hybrid GIS architectures
* Data automation and geoprocessing workflows
* Leadership and team management
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving
* Technical depth in GIS systems and development
* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to obtain and maintain federal security clearance (e.g., NAC/NACI)
* Occasional travel for client meetings, training, or field coordination

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience supporting federal clients or large\-scale geospatial programs
* Knowledge of water resources, environmental science, or land management applications
* Familiarity with remote sensing, GPS data collection, and modeling tools (e.g., hydrologic models)
* Experience integrating GIS with external systems or enterprise applications
* Relevant GIS certifications (e.g., GISP) or ESRI technical certifications

**Must have a valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to pass a driving record background check.**

jobs.title: Project Geologist / Scientist
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**


This position will design and implement appropriate technical services to ensure that client and project management needs are met. Position includes performing field and office tasks as well as providing project management support for traditional assessment and remediation projects.


**Position Requirements**


* Bachelor’s degree in relevant technical field.
* Minimum of 4 years in the environmental consulting industry with demonstrated progression in technical site investigation / remediation and task management.
* Proficient in designing field programs and managing projects and associated field activities – scheduling, coordination of tasks, budgeting, subcontractor negotiating/management.
* Experience planning, coordinating, and managing Site/Remedial Investigation field activities and performing follow up intermediate hydrogeologic and data interpretation.
* Demonstrated task/project management skills.
* Intermediate data evaluation and analytical skills.
* Proficient written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience with common technical protocols and regulatory requirements.
* Ability and willingness to support the technical growth of staff level professionals based on direct hands\-on interactions.

  




**Essential Duties**


* Field Coordination and Management:
	+ Set up work plans and protocols, supervise field activities, coordinate field personnel and related activities for the purpose of implementing technically sound project plans. May also include implementation of field activities.
* Technical Data Review and Report Preparation:
	+ Coordinate the collection and review of project data, including the reduction of field data to evaluate and determine future client needs and project requirements. Interpret data, develop, and finalize a report for Project Manager’s review that appropriately documents findings and project remediation recommendations.
* Project Management:
	+ Ensure that individual task schedules, budgets, and client invoicing are monitored and reviewed in compliance with Company standards and client requirements to complete project work.
* Staff Mentoring and Training:
	+ Participate in the development of junior staff and work with senior management to continue to grow as a consultant and leader of the firm.

**Physical Demands/Work Environment Conditions**


This position works in the field as well as the office environment. In the field, candidate will be working independently or leading a larger team at exterior project sites (i.e., industrial/brownfield facilities, monitoring wells, treatment systems, construction projects) to perform sample collection, recording of operational/meter parameters, and oversight of subcontractors (e.g., drillers, heavy equipment operators, truckers). These field activities require the ability to drive to different project sites and physically move around outdoors in various terrains, in adverse weather conditions and occasionally for extended or irregular hours. Conducting work involves the use of hand\-held monitoring instruments and tools, as well as water sampling equipment, which requires the ability to routinely lift and carry objects, stand, walk, reach, bend, squat, kneel and twist. Office work is primarily stationary/sedentary using a computer and keyboard/mouse requiring repetitive hand movements.

  

*Roux is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital status, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or protected veteran status; and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.*


*Roux will take steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the position, please contact* *HR@rouxinc.com**.*

  

Base Salary Range: $85,000 \- $115,000\. This salary range is based on what Roux in good faith believes it might pay at the time of posting for this position and for this geographic location. Actual compensation may vary based on job\-related factors such as relevant work experience, market conditions, education/training, certifications, skill sets, and internal equity. In addition, this position is eligible for performance bonuses based on individual job performance and the profitability of the firm.

jobs.title: GIS Technician - Part Time - On Call
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM** is actively seeking a highly motivated Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Technician III. The candidate may work remotely or from the Omaha, NE AECOM office.

**The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:**

* Independently executes and delivers GIS projects varying from basic to moderate to significant scopes and complexity.
* Develop databases and various mapping outputs to support reports and other project deliverables.
* Create, organize, manipulate, and retrieve GIS data for reporting, analysis, and presentation purposes.
* Perform quality assurance of GIS data and associated graphic components.
* Use concepts, practices, and procedures to extract and provide GIS data to clients.
* Prepare and maintain internal and external project documentation, including quality control documentation.
* Provide support to AECOM’s Military Munitions Response information dashboard.
* Work directly with Level I/II/III/IV GIS Specialists and Project Managers.

 **Qualifications** ***MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:***

* High school diploma \+4 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/ or education
* U.S. Citizenship required
* Successful candidate will have to pass a background check.

***PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:***

* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, or a related field.
* Strong communications skills and ability to independently manage workload schedules1\+ years of GIS or other relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
* Experience with ArcMap, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Portal and/or other relevant ArcGIS software and an understanding of the ESRI suite of products.
* AutoCAD experience.
* Technical knowledge of geographic concepts, including coordinate systems, data collection methods, spatial data management, analysis, data visualization and cartographic design.

  

**Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**


You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:

Includes interchange, generation and settlement point bidirectional electric power demand and energy management data. Responsible for providing data acquisition and analysis in a reliable, timely and secure manner and ensure accuracy and availability of the data for use by multiple internal and external users.


**Note:** There is one position available and the position will be filled at one of four job grade levels: Meter Data Analyst I, job grade 6; Meter Data Analyst II, job grade 7, Meter Data Analyst III, job grade 8; or Senior Meter Data Analyst, job grade 9\. This decision will be based on the qualifications and experience of the candidate selected, and Tri\-State business needs at the time of hire.

jobs.title: BCT Partners – Data Management Specialist
jobs.description:
About BCT  

We harness the power of expertise and innovation to solve complex social problems, transform lives, and create lasting change.
  

  

BCT is a management consulting firm that tackles complex social problems through data analytics, innovative solutions and program management. We believe complex issues are best solved through collaboration. As a result, we employ a multidisciplinary approach that combines domain expertise, research, evaluation, technology, organizational development, and a passion for change.
  

  

To learn more about how we live our values of Ubuntu (“I am because we are”) and our mission, go to our website and follow us on social media.
  

https://www.bctpartners.com/  

  

**About the Role:**  

The Data Management Specialist supports data management, reporting, workflow tracking, and customer service functions for Head Start and Early Head Start grant recipients in partnership with the Regional Office of Head Start. This role helps ensure the accuracy, quality, and accessibility of grant\-related data used to support program oversight, grant administration, operational effectiveness, and informed decision\-making. The Data Management Specialist maintains data processes, monitors workflow systems, supports reporting and analysis efforts, resolves data\-related issues, and collaborates with stakeholders to improve data quality, streamline operations, and support positive outcomes for children and families.  

  

*Please refer to the “Our Client \& This Project” section at the bottom of this job posting to learn more.*  

  

**How You Contribute to the Team:*** Perform data validation, cleansing, standardization, and quality assurance activities to maintain accurate and reliable datasets.
* Review, analyze, and resolve data discrepancies, inconsistencies, and duplicate records across multiple systems and repositories.
* Maintain and manage metadata, records, and documentation in compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and data governance standards.
* Support the implementation and enforcement of data management best practices, standards, and workflows.
* Utilize Excel, Smartsheet, and other data management tools to organize, track, analyze, and report on data\-related activities.
* Conduct basic SQL queries to validate data, generate reports, and support data analysis activities.
* Assist with the administration and maintenance of document management systems and electronic records repositories.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, data dictionaries, logs, and reporting materials.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve data issues, and improve data management processes.
* Support records retention and compliance initiatives by ensuring proper handling, storage, and documentation of organizational records.
* Monitor data quality metrics and recommend corrective actions or process improvements where necessary.
* Ensure confidentiality, integrity, and security of sensitive information in accordance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Participate in audits, reviews, and data governance initiatives as required.

  

Perform these and other reasonable tasks as assigned by management in support of BCT’s goals and objectives.  

  

**What You Bring to the Table:**  

**As no individual candidate meets every qualification, we encourage candidates who meet most of these requirements to apply!**  

  

**Educational Requirements:*** Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Library Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
* Relevant certifications in data management, records management, or information governance are a plus.

**Experience Requirements:*** 3 years of relevant post\-baccalaureate professional experience in data management, records management, metadata management, document management, or related fields.
* Experience supporting data quality assurance, data governance, or enterprise data management initiatives preferred.
* Prior experience working with large datasets and document repositories in a professional environment is highly desirable.

**Skills and Expertise:*** Working knowledge of data governance principles, data lifecycle management, and records management standards.
* Experience performing data quality assurance, validation, cleansing, and reconciliation activities.
* Familiarity with metadata management concepts and best practices.
* Experience using document management systems and electronic records management platforms.
* Basic SQL skills with the ability to run queries and validate data.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple assignments in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and related business applications.
* Ability to interpret policies, procedures, and technical documentation.
* Strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality.

**Communication Skills:*** Proven ability to effectively communicate to various audiences when speaking and in writing.
* Must be able to communicate, collaborate and interact with colleagues in a remote work environment; must participate in virtual meetings, appear on camera as needed, and contribute to meeting content as required.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Smartsheet, including data analysis, tracking, reporting, and management functions.
* Experience with video meetings/conferencing (e.g., Zoom, Adobe, MS Teams).
* Ability to adapt quickly to new applications.

**There are multiple factors considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align with the specified role, geographic location, education as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position.*

new_jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM** is actively seeking a highly motivated Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Technician III. The candidate may work remotely or from the Omaha, NE AECOM office.

**The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:**

* Independently executes and delivers GIS projects varying from basic to moderate to significant scopes and complexity.
* Develop databases and various mapping outputs to support reports and other project deliverables.
* Create, organize, manipulate, and retrieve GIS data for reporting, analysis, and presentation purposes.
* Perform quality assurance of GIS data and associated graphic components.
* Use concepts, practices, and procedures to extract and provide GIS data to clients.
* Prepare and maintain internal and external project documentation, including quality control documentation.
* Provide support to AECOM’s Military Munitions Response information dashboard.
* Work directly with Level I/II/III/IV GIS Specialists and Project Managers.

 **Qualifications** ***MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:***

* High school diploma \+4 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/ or education
* U.S. Citizenship required
* Successful candidate will have to pass a background check.

***PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:***

* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, or a related field.
* Strong communications skills and ability to independently manage workload schedules1\+ years of GIS or other relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
* Experience with ArcMap, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Portal and/or other relevant ArcGIS software and an understanding of the ESRI suite of products.
* AutoCAD experience.
* Technical knowledge of geographic concepts, including coordinate systems, data collection methods, spatial data management, analysis, data visualization and cartographic design.

  

**Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**


You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
